zh.title: 林飛帆：台灣打造非紅無人機鏈 烏克蘭尋求合作擺脫中國零件
zh.summary: 國安會副秘書長林飛帆稱無人機出口增55倍；烏克蘭接觸台廠擺脫中製零件
body: 國家安全會議副秘書長林飛帆19日在總統府全社會防衛韌性國際論壇表示，台灣正積極打造無人機非紅供應鏈，已有許多烏克蘭友人與台灣接觸，希望擺脫對中國無人機零組件的依賴。
林飛帆指出，台灣無人機出口近一年成長55倍，最大買家為波蘭和捷克，台灣具備生產百分之百國製零組件的能力。受限於外交與簽證因素，派員赴烏克蘭較不易，但可邀請烏克蘭人來台交流。政府另推動無人機特別條例與追加預算，補足國防部急需三型無人機。

en.title: Taiwan Builds Non-Red Drone Supply Chain as Ukraine Seeks to Reduce China Dependence
en.summary: NSC Deputy Secretary-General Lin Fei-fan says drone exports up 55-fold; Ukraine contacts Taiwan firms to cut China reliance
body: National Security Council Deputy Secretary-General Lin Fei-fan said at the Presidential Office's Whole-of-Society Defense Resilience Forum on 19 September that Taiwan is actively building a "non-red" drone supply chain, with many Ukrainian contacts seeking to reduce reliance on Chinese drone components.

Lin stated Taiwan's drone exports grew 55-fold in the past year, with Poland and the Czech Republic as the largest buyers, and that Taiwan can produce 100% domestically made components. Diplomatic and visa hurdles make sending personnel to Ukraine difficult, but Taiwan can host Ukrainian visitors. The government is also advancing a Drone Special Act and supplementary budget to procure three types of drones urgently needed by the Ministry of National Defense.
